changes.text: Implemented a Global UI Component Library to standardize all developer and player interfaces, drastically reducing HTML DOM bloat.
Overhauled the entire UI theme with a cohesive dark panel design, vibrant gradient headers, and a strict 8px spacing grid.
Refactored over a dozen legacy windows (Power Editor, Trade, Inventory, Trainers, Player/NPC Managers) to the new unified component standard.
Arcade Cabinets can now be given custom names via the Arcade Editor, which persist in the world and display natively on the 3D hover HUD!
Resolved a ghosting issue in the Player Manager where players would occasionally appear duplicated.
Implemented an A* pathfinding algorithm for Click-to-Move, allowing the player to automatically route around buildings, fences, and walls.
Click-to-Move now features intelligent hazard avoidance, naturally pathing around lava, acid, and water when possible.
Click-to-Move now automatically evaluates terrain elevation and executes jumps to vault over obstacles in your path.
Added a dynamic, glowing 3D path line to visualize your Click-to-Move route. The line turns orange if the only available path forces you through a hazard.
You can now hold down Left-Click to continuously update your Click-to-Move path in real-time.
Clicking Right-Click while holding Left-Click during Click-to-Move will now manually trigger a jump.
Restored the pulsating target ring visual indicator when using Click-to-Move.
Added a 'Show Click-to-Move Path' toggle to the Settings Menu.
Added wandering 'Troggles' and a structured 7-stage learning curve to Number Munchers to balance the early-game difficulty.
Added a classic 'Level Clear' fanfare to Number Munchers and the Arcade Audio system.
Added floating 'Press [T] to Talk/Play' indicators above nearby NPCs and Arcade Cabinets for seamless keyboard interaction.
Holding Shift while pressing 'R' in Edit Mode will now reverse the cycle direction of builder shapes.
Safeguarded the server against corrupted 0-byte character save files, preventing fatal crashes during login and background data syncs.
Fixed an issue where newly added builder preview shapes (like Top Slabs and Half Ramps) would occasionally freeze on the screen.
Fixed an issue where the Builder Texture Palette dropdown would appear empty until manually refreshed.
Added 'Number Munchers' (Math) to the Arcade! Eat numbers based on Multiples, Factors, and Primes while dodging wandering Troggles.
Added new builder block shapes: Top Slabs, Half Ramps, and Top Half Ramps for complex sloped structures.
Arcade Cabinets now render physical 3D screens directly into the game world, complete with dynamic glowing screen light.
Added a Right-Click Context Menu to Arcade Cabinets for quick access to playing, and Developer options for editing and power toggling.
Added a global 'Mute Arcade Sounds' toggle to the Settings menu.
Added 'Potato Mode' to the loading screen, allowing players to instantly drop graphics settings if loading takes too long.
Loading screens now cycle through game tips, and system texts seamlessly highlight important keybinds and commands.
Added floating score indicators to Pixel for collecting coins, powerups, and bouncing on enemies.
Upgraded the Builder Tool's shape selector to a dropdown list for easier access to the growing roster of shapes.
Added 24 new transparent decal street lines to the Object Library, including corners, T-intersections, and pedestrian crosswalks.
Added a new Vertical (Z-Axis) drag mode for the builder tool to effortlessly drag-and-build walls and pillars.
Added dynamic Fence blocks that automatically connect to adjacent solid blocks and other fences.
Implemented the '/grant' and '/revoke' commands alongside the Player Modifier UI for real-time global permission management.
Enforced a 3-character maximum limit per account during the character creation process.
Drafted the Stable Prototype Build v2.4.0! The core engine foundations for 3D networking, chunk meshing, and asset management are now fully solidified.
The engine is now fully prepared to scale into Issue 1 gameplay and mechanic development.
Released 'Bepis' (Tetris clone) and 'Operius' (Pseudo-3D Tube Shooter), officially concluding B's First Generation Arcade Finale!
There are now 8 fully playable, networked arcade cabinets available to place in your zones: Pixel, Bonk, Invaders, B-Man, Flappy Bee, Pixel-Cross, Bepis, and Operius.
Fixed an issue in Operius where the player's ship would eventually outrun its own bullets at high speeds.
Introduced three brand new arcade games: B-Man, Flappy Bee, and Pixel-Cross!
Added a new 3D Cabinet Highlighter tool to the Arcade Manager, rendering a neon wireframe box around the cabinet you are actively editing.
The Arcade Manager now features a Global Leaderboard display to easily view the reigning high scores across all installed games.
Safeguarded the Chunk Mesher to prevent Arcade Cabinets from popping in completely invisible during heavy world loads.
Introduced the interactive Arcade System to the game world. Players can now interact with arcade cabinet furniture to play mini-games.
Added three fully playable classic arcade mini-games: Bonk, Pixel, and Invaders.
Arcade cabinets now feature networked high-score leaderboards. Show off your skills and compete with other players.
Bonk supports networked 2-player matchmaking! Queue up and face off against other players in real-time.
Resolved an issue where the 'Connection Lost' overlay would persistently display when safely returning to the character selection or login screens.
Added Cutout Transparency to the engine's shaders. 3D objects like doors can now feature transparent windows while maintaining perfect depth-sorting and shadows.
Introduced the 'useMeshUV' registry flag. Builders can now map dynamic hotbar materials seamlessly onto complex Blockbench Per-Face UV coordinates.
Upgraded the Builder Tools placement preview. The ghost block now perfectly projects 3D furniture meshes, custom textures, and directional rotations before you build.
Patched a silent crash in the Chunk Mesher Web Worker that caused standard terrain to vanish when placing new blocks.
Successfully refactored the server architecture to a Multi-Zone MMO framework! Players can now seamlessly exist, chat, build, and fight in completely isolated dimensions on the exact same server.
Introduced the Zone Manager UI to the Developer Tools, allowing for real-time creation and hot-swapping between different worlds.
The Player Manager now actively tracks and displays which zone each player is currently exploring.
Added the '/joinzone' command to instantly warp to new dimensions, and updated the Help & Commands menu to list all new multi-zone developer tools.
Fixed a critical crash in the Chunk Mesher where deleted (null) blocks were accidentally being processed as transparent geometry.
Resolved a desync in the network layer where the full map payload was occasionally parsed before the async deserializer finished wiping the old cache.
Massive client performance overhaul! Moved the Greedy Chunk Mesher to a dedicated Web Worker thread for zero-stutter background terrain generation.
Implemented a Zero-Copy Memory Pool between threads, completely eliminating Garbage Collection stutter and memory spikes during rapid chunk loading.
Upgraded terrain generation to use 16x16x16 vertical sub-chunks, unlocking true 3D Frustum Culling to hide underground chunks and save massive GPU resources.
Added IndexedDB Caching for Chunk Geometry. The game now 'bakes' the world to your browser, allowing previously explored areas to load almost instantly.
Replaced the legacy Canvas 2D UI for combat text and nameplates with a blazing fast WebGL Sprite Batcher. Text now scales smoothly and hides properly behind terrain!
Water and fluid blocks now intelligently cull their interior faces across chunk borders, resulting in perfectly smooth, seamless transparent surfaces.
Fixed infinite loading screen hangs and UI bleed issues that occurred during the initial player spawning sequence.
Introduced the Player Manager and Player Modifier UIs for administrators to securely oversee and edit character states, levels, and powers in real-time.
Implemented a dual-cost energy system. Powers can now simultaneously consume and regenerate both standard Energy and Battery Charge (formerly Synthetic Energy).
Day/Night lighting transitions are now buttery smooth, actively blending colors and shadow intensities across the horizon instead of aggressively snapping.
The HUD now accurately displays Active Toggles (Green) and Passive Abilities (Blue) alongside your temporary status effects.
Added the 'solar_recovery' engine script to allow passives to regenerate Battery Charge specifically during daylight hours.
Fixed an issue where particle effects (like Super Speed steps) were animating globally in sync rather than tracking independent visual lifespans.
Separated the Power Hotbar layout from Known Powers. Passive abilities will no longer forcibly slot themselves onto your bar upon logging in.
Resolved a server/client desync that caused severe rubberbanding when using toggles like the Flashlight alongside casted abilities.
Fixed synchronization desyncs in the Settings Menu. Pressing hotkeys (like 'N' for Nameplates) now actively updates the visual state of the toggles while the menu is open.
The 'Inherited' powerset no longer enforces a sequential unlock path. You can now train utility powers (like Solar Power Recovery or Jetpack) in any order from the Trainer and Character Creator.
Completely overhauled the Power Customization Engine UI with a new multi-column layout, dynamic scrolling lists, and context-aware disabled states.
Built a fully isolated 3D WebGL Live Preview canvas inside the Power Customizer, complete with a timeline scrubber to visualize cast, projectile, and impact animations.
Ripped out static combat stats and replaced them with a modular Effects Engine. Powers can now stack multiple Damage, Healing, and DoT procs with customizable trigger chances.
Expanded Base Properties to support Range, AoE/Cone Radii, Crit Chance, Crit Multipliers, Activation Times, and dynamic Energy Sources.
Introduced a multi-stage Visuals Engine with chronologically chained arrays for Caster, Projectile, and Target sprite events, featuring adjustable height offsets, sorting, and timing delays.
Added the /level command for developers to skip to a specific level and automatically receive the correct number of unspent Power and Powerset picks.
Unhooked hardcoded logic from standard powers (Brawl, Throw Airplane, Teleport) so they can be fully modified and hot-swapped via the Customizer.
Massive performance overhaul: Implemented frustum-based chunk rendering, time-sliced mesh generation, and time-budgeted background chunk loading.
Added distance-based Garbage Collection to automatically unload distant chunks and prevent memory leaks.
Added the 'Flashlight' power! Illuminates the dark with a directional beam, casts real-time shadows, and uses Synthetic Energy.
Introduced 'Synthetic Energy' as a new stat. It drains when using tech like the Flashlight and recharges passively during the daytime.
Super-speed operators can now run across the surface of water if they build up enough momentum!
Added dynamic weather! Rain and snow particles now fall globally, complete with splashes and ripples on liquid surfaces.
Added robust Graphics Settings to both the main menu and in-game UI: Tweak your Render Distance, Render Scale (3D Resolution), and Max Dynamic Lights for huge FPS gains.
Added live numeric value indicators to all sliders in the settings menu.
Fixed an issue where the player's own shadow would block their flashlight beam or spin wildly when rotating the camera by utilizing an invisible shadow proxy.
Drastically optimized network packet parsing and minimap generation to eliminate micro-stutters when moving.
Refactored the renderer drawing logic to significantly improve performance.
Fixed an issue where lava and acid slabs weren't dealing environmental damage.
Super-speed now allows you to run across the surface of water if you're fast enough!
Fixed the UI scaling so the health and energy bars don't get messed up.
Teleporting aims a lot better now.
Lava slabs will actually burn you if you step in them.
You can drag the minimap around now! Made it so you can see your character while the big map is open.
You can now right-click the minimap to put down waypoints.
Fixed shooting and burning damage so the server handles it (no cheating!).
Rewrote the contributing guide to be super clear that we don't use generative AI.
